description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR… What an extraordinary week on the Rescue Colorado Tour. I continue to be surprised — not by the opposition, not by the noise — but by the caliber and character of the people we are meeting across this state. Last night we held a fundraiser in downtown Denver. I was warned repeatedly that Denver would be “difficult ground.” I was told independents would be hard to reach. I was told Democrats wouldn’t show up. The event was hosted by a long-time Democrat. In attend
title: TEAM VICTOR WEEKLY UPDATE March 1, 2026
